digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verify workflow
propositions: YAML parsing in _bridge_schedule called 1,440 times inside test comprehension consumes 7.9s per-cell; hoisting parse/reuse eliminates 5.7 runner-minutes per Verified run without reducing exhaustive minute checks

Pandoc corpus test renders all 232 eligible units with real subprocess but asserts only cardinality witnesses; exact short-circuit reaches both in 0.035s with 1 subprocess and preserves assertion class

Pandoc hardening suite invokes both current and legacy converters for all 884 units, with legacy now replaced by immutable expected outputs while keeping all 884 live product conversions, eliminating 883 redundant subprocesses and 18.8s per-cell cost
AST provenance fixture setup 46-55s repeats caller/parent discovery across ~9.5M iterations; indexing once per process preserves all 24 contract tuples and saves ~3.37s setup time

Complexity-lock policy runs identically in every Python/OS matrix cell; moving single invocation to lint job and deleting duplicates saves ~154 runner-seconds (2.57 runner-minutes) without reducing assertions

Same-change Gerrit Verify cancellation failed under always() status predicates on 1,788/1,790; switching to !cancelled() status check resolves 1,500+ second predecessor-queue blocks while preserving classifier-failure fallback
